arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.amount_cents,b.amount_cents ba from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"
select charge_id,booking_id,idempotency_key,state,amount_cents from charges where state is not "captured" or booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings)

select event_id,booking_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,40) p from outbox where status!="delivered" and (booking_id!=json_extract(payload,"$.booking_id") or json_extract(payload,"$.schema_version")!=1)

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck,(select count(*) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and o.status="delivered") ev from bookings b where ck!=1 or ev!=1
select status,count(*) n,min(json_extract(payload,"$.schema_version")) mn,max(json_extract(payload,"$.schema_version")) mx from outbox group by status
select status,path,message,count(*) n from request_logs where service="booking" or 1 group by 1,2,3 order by n desc limit 20
select count(*) n, count(distinct client_reference) d from bookings where status="confirmed" and client_reference is not null
select booking_id,count(*) from charges group by 1 having count(*)>1

select b.booking_id,b.client_reference,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.passenger_id,b.created_step,c.charge_id,c.state from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where client_reference in (select client_reference from bookings where status="confirmed" group by 1 having count(*)>1)

select b.*,c.charge_id,c.state from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where client_reference in (select client_reference from bookings where status="confirmed" group by 1 having count(*)>1)
